calls: DOWNGRADE: 1930s power suiting is an AW26 runway moment only. SS27 (Loro Piana 'Solutions For', Sept 28; Milan men's SS27; Armani's lived-in tailoring) and the AW26 long raglan overcoat point to soft construction, the direction a 2027 launch should build on. Relaxed pleated trousers now span both seasons.

CORRECTION: Run 07 stretched Cenomi mall data into 'domestic luxury held up.' Bain-Altagamma: Gulf luxury consumer base −15–25% in H1 2026. Counterpoint: Zegna's Middle East business stayed positive in Q2, and ZEGNA DTC grew +18.6% in H1. Size the first buy smaller; anchor on tailoring.

Timing: Riyadh Fashion Week (Oct 15–20) lineup still unpublished; Riyadh Season opens Oct 21 for 10 weeks, making late Oct to Dec the peak window. Westfield Riyadh was scheduled for Sept, opening unconfirmed.
White-space proof: 13 of the 14 brands on Grazia ME's Saudi National Day list are not menswear. Homegrown Saudi men's luxury has no owner. Mihyar (~60 stores) added as the scaled thobe incumbent.

Top of market raises the provenance bar: Loro Piana opened a vertically integrated knitwear centre (Ghemme). Storytelling register is archive- and museum-led (Menil Collection campaign; Braidense library installation) and framed by use case.
